CreationSetupIntro: Configure the workspace for this new project, then click Initialize to create it and install the agent templates.
OnboardingIntro1: KittyClaw is a kanban that orchestrates agentic projects. Each column is a stage, tickets flow between stages, and LLM agents (programmer, groomer, producer, QA, committer, code-janitor, evaluator) pick up and process them automatically based on triggers you configure.
OnboardingIntro2: Create a project, point it at a workspace folder, then choose the right agent provider: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Grok Build, or Ollama.
OnboardingClaudeGuidance: Executable: claude. Configure PATH or KITTYCLAW_CLAUDE_BIN.
OnboardingCodexGuidance: Executable: codex. Configure PATH or KITTYCLAW_CODEX_BIN.
OnboardingGrokGuidance: Executable: grok. Configure PATH, ~/.grok/bin, or KITTYCLAW_GROK_BIN.
OnboardingMistralGuidance: Executable: vibe. Configure PATH or KITTYCLAW_MISTRAL_BIN.
OnboardingOllamaGuidance: Executable: ollama. Configure PATH; local models also require Claude Code as transport.
OnboardingMissingWarning: KittyClaw needs at least one available agent provider. Git is also required for version-control operations. Install what is missing, then click Recheck.
OnboardingProviderHint: Only one agent provider is required. The others are optional and can be installed later. Ollama models currently use Claude Code as their transport.
